name: fms
description: This is the Firewall Manager API Reference.

subcommands.name: associate-admin-account
subcommands.description: Sets a Firewall Manager default administrator account.

subcommands.name: associate-third-party-firewall
subcommands.description: Sets the Firewall Manager policy administrator as a tenant administrator of a third-party firewall service.

subcommands.name: batch-associate-resource
subcommands.description: Associate resources to a Firewall Manager resource set.

subcommands.name: batch-disassociate-resource
subcommands.description: Disassociates resources from a Firewall Manager resource set.

subcommands.name: delete-apps-list
subcommands.description: Permanently deletes an Firewall Manager applications list.

subcommands.name: delete-notification-channel
subcommands.description: Deletes an Firewall Manager association with the IAM role and the Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) topic that is used to record Firewall Manager SNS logs.

subcommands.name: delete-policy
subcommands.description: Permanently deletes an Firewall Manager policy.

subcommands.name: delete-protocols-list
subcommands.description: Permanently deletes an Firewall Manager protocols list.

subcommands.name: delete-resource-set
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified ResourceSet.

subcommands.name: disassociate-admin-account
subcommands.description: Disassociates an Firewall Manager administrator account.

subcommands.name: disassociate-third-party-firewall
subcommands.description: Disassociates a Firewall Manager policy administrator from a third-party firewall tenant.

subcommands.name: get-admin-account
subcommands.description: Returns the Organizations account that is associated with Firewall Manager as the Firewall Manager default administrator.

subcommands.name: get-admin-scope
subcommands.description: Returns information about the specified account's administrative scope.

subcommands.name: get-apps-list
subcommands.description: Returns information about the specified Firewall Manager applications list.

subcommands.name: get-compliance-detail
subcommands.description: Returns detailed compliance information about the specified member account.

subcommands.name: get-notification-channel
subcommands.description: Information about the Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) topic that is used to record Firewall Manager SNS logs.

subcommands.name: get-policy
subcommands.description: Returns information about the specified Firewall Manager policy.

subcommands.name: get-protection-status
subcommands.description: If you created a Shield Advanced policy, returns policy-level attack summary information in the event of a potential DDoS attack.

subcommands.name: get-protocols-list
subcommands.description: Returns information about the specified Firewall Manager protocols list.

subcommands.name: get-resource-set
subcommands.description: Gets information about a specific resource set.

subcommands.name: get-third-party-firewall-association-status
subcommands.description: The onboarding status of a Firewall Manager admin account to third-party firewall vendor tenant.

subcommands.name: get-violation-details
subcommands.description: Retrieves violations for a resource based on the specified Firewall Manager policy and Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-admin-accounts-for-organization
subcommands.description: Returns a AdminAccounts object that lists the Firewall Manager administrators within the organization that are onboarded to Firewall Manager by AssociateAdminAccount.

subcommands.name: list-admins-managing-account
subcommands.description: Lists the accounts that are managing the specified Organizations member account.

subcommands.name: list-apps-lists
subcommands.description: Returns an array of AppsListDataSummary objects.

subcommands.name: list-compliance-status
subcommands.description: Returns an array of PolicyComplianceStatus objects.

subcommands.name: list-discovered-resources
subcommands.description: Returns an array of resources in the organization's accounts that are available to be associated with a resource set.

subcommands.name: list-member-accounts
subcommands.description: Returns a MemberAccounts object that lists the member accounts in the administrator's Amazon Web Services organization.

subcommands.name: list-policies
subcommands.description: Returns an array of PolicySummary objects.

subcommands.name: list-protocols-lists
subcommands.description: Returns an array of ProtocolsListDataSummary objects.

subcommands.name: list-resource-set-resources
subcommands.description: Returns an array of resources that are currently associated to a resource set.

subcommands.name: list-resource-sets
subcommands.description: Returns an array of ResourceSetSummary objects.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Retrieves the list of tags for the specified Amazon Web Services resource.

subcommands.name: list-third-party-firewall-firewall-policies
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of all of the third-party firewall policies that are associated with the third-party firewall administrator's account.

subcommands.name: put-admin-account
subcommands.description: Creates or updates an Firewall Manager administrator account.

subcommands.name: put-apps-list
subcommands.description: Creates an Firewall Manager applications list.

subcommands.name: put-notification-channel
subcommands.description: Designates the IAM role and Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) topic that Firewall Manager uses to record SNS logs.

subcommands.name: put-policy
subcommands.description: Creates an Firewall Manager policy.

subcommands.name: put-protocols-list
subcommands.description: Creates an Firewall Manager protocols list.

subcommands.name: put-resource-set
subcommands.description: Creates the resource set.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to an Amazon Web Services resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from an Amazon Web Services resource.
